items.content_html: OSINT Terminal is a lightweight JavaScript tray/terminal that you inject into a webpage (console/bookmarklet) to perform fast browser-based reconnaissance and analysis. It intercepts fetch and XMLHttpRequest, inspects DOM/meta/scripts, hunts for tokens (JWTs, API keys). Intended for authorized testing and internal audits only.
